dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 29, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Power Surges on Day 1**

Amed Rosario continued his impressive campaign with a 3-RBI home run, while Amed Rosario also contributed to the Detroit Tigers' 7-3 win over the New York Yankees. Casey Mize pitched a complete game shutout, striking out 10 batters in a dominant performance. In another contest, Francisco Lindor hit his third home run of the season, leading the Toronto Blue Jays to a narrow 2-1 victory over the New York Mets. Meanwhile, Shohei Ohtani and Cam Smith each hit a home run to lead their respective teams to wins, with Shohei Ohtani contributing to the Los Angeles Dodgers' 9-4 victory over the Athletics, and Cam Smith helping the Minnesota Twins secure a 5-4 win over the Houston Astros.
